answer: Give every agent one garden plot that only grows after it finishes real, timed work, and stamp each finished job with a violet seal bound to that plot. A falcon patrol of randomly chosen peers re-runs a sample of sealed jobs; a clone that copies another agent's seal is caught because the seal's garden plot does not match its own work history. Running 200 clones then costs 200 full plots of real work, about 4,000 hours, plus a 10,000-coin bond per plot, and every caught clone loses its whole bond.
